APPLICATION FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68511.3 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF CRAWFORD, JIMMY ORDER GRANTING WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO CRC 3.50 - 3.63

STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE JUDGE PRO TEM MARK SCHREIBER FILED BY CRAWFORD, JIMMY COMBS, EVE
SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-07-2009 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-07-2009 BY JUDGE PRO TEM: MARK SCHREIBER. APPEARANCES BY BOTH PARTIES. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-07-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CRAWFORD, JIMMY IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT COMBS, EVE EVEN AFTER REDUCING THE AMOUNT CLAIMED BY THE LANDLORD FOR CARPET REPLACEMENT, LOCK REPLACEMENT, AND CLEANING, AND ELIMINATING LATE CHARGES ON RENT NOT PAID, THE AMOUNT OF THE SECURITY DEPOSIT PLUS INTEREST IS LESS THAN THE DEDUCTIONS PROPERLY CLAIMED BY THE LANDLORD. THEREFORE, PLAINTIFF IS STILL NOT DUE A REFUND OF THE SECURITY DEPOSIT IN ANY AMOUNT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
